title: Introduction to NestJS
content: NestJS is a progressive Node.js framework for building efficient, reliable and scalable server-side applications. It uses TypeScript by default and combines elements of OOP, FP, and FRP.

title: Vector Databases Overview
content: Vector databases store data as high-dimensional vectors and enable similarity search. They are essential for AI applications like semantic search, recommendation systems, and retrieval-augmented generation.

title: Qdrant Introduction
content: Qdrant is a vector similarity search engine and database. It provides a production-ready service with a convenient API to store, search, and manage vectors with an additional payload.

title: Google Gemini API
content: Google Gemini is a family of multimodal AI models developed by Google DeepMind. The Gemini API provides access to these models for tasks like text generation, embedding creation, and multimodal understanding.

title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
content: RAG is an AI framework that retrieves relevant documents from a knowledge base to augment prompts sent to a language model. It improves accuracy and grounds responses in factual data.

title: Embeddings Explained
content: Embeddings are numerical representations of data (text, images, etc.) as dense vectors in a high-dimensional space. Similar items have embeddings that are close together, enabling semantic similarity search.

title: NestJS Dependency Injection
content: NestJS uses a powerful Dependency Injection (DI) system based on decorators. Services are injectable providers that can be shared across modules, promoting reusability and testability.

title: TypeScript Best Practices
content: TypeScript adds static typing to JavaScript, catching errors at compile time. Best practices include using strict mode, defining interfaces for data shapes, and leveraging generics for reusable code.

title: REST API Design
content: RESTful APIs use HTTP methods (GET, POST, PUT, DELETE) to perform CRUD operations on resources. Good REST design includes meaningful endpoints, proper status codes, and consistent response formats.

title: Cosine Similarity
content: Cosine similarity measures the cosine of the angle between two vectors, indicating their directional similarity. It is widely used in vector search to rank documents by semantic relevance to a query.
